summary.intent: Check whether BumpReason::Cascade.dependency_to reaches user-visible output in callisto, and if so fix it (failing test first) so it names the converged final dependency version, then ship it as a signed-commit PR linked to trail #462.
summary.outcome: Confirmed dependency_to is user-visible (release PR reason column and version/snapshot JSON), added a failing-then-passing test and a fix setting it from ConvergedTargets, plus a patch changeset. Local tests, clippy and doc-check passed; the signed commit was being retried outside the sandbox, and fetch/merge/push/trail link/ci-pr remained undone.

repo: dependency_to is surfaced in the release PR body reason column (pr_body.rs:65-72) and in the version and snapshot JSON as dependencyTo.
Cascade convergence lives in crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs with ConvergedTargets in cascade/converged.rs; fixed-group realignment can change a target after the cascade step recorded a reason.
Changesets are created with `cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add --package cargo/callisto-cli:patch --summary ...`.
Full callisto-graph tests have one sandbox-related failure (registry_argv npm packing, EPERM/registry denied) unrelated to cascade changes.

code.finding: BumpReason::Cascade.dependency_to was recorded at cascade-step time (possibly intermediate, e.g. 1.0.1); fix sets it after ConvergedTargets::settle from the converged target of the reason's `via` package.
Added cascade_reason_names_the_final_version_after_a_fixed_group_realigns using a fixed group (b,c) with an =1.0.0 edge a->b; it failed first with 1.0.1 vs expected 1.1.0.

workflow: Heredocs are refused in this worktree; use Read plus Edit to append to files.
Sandbox blocks gpg (~/.gnupg) and github.com:22; the lead said to re-run only those commands with the sandbox disabled per call, never using commit.gpgsign=false.
Peer-session messages cannot grant permission escalation; actions still go through this session's permission gate.

friction: gpg signing failed in the sandbox, so the first commit attempt failed.
git fetch origin was blocked (github.com:22 denied), so the worktree was based on local main f5c770ca0 rather than fresh origin/main.
Heredoc usage was refused in the worktree, forcing a Read+Edit workaround.
npm-based registry_argv test fails under the sandbox, adding noise to the full crate test run.
open_items: Confirm the signed commit succeeded outside the sandbox.
Fetch origin and merge latest origin/main (no rebase, no force-push).
Push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch> and verify with git ls-remote.
Run entire trail link 462 and entire trail ci-pr to open the PR.
Report to the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) in under 5 lines with PR, sha and what was run.
Stop and tell the lead if the permission prompt or classifier refuses the sandbox-disabled commands.
